name: @murmur/chat-service
description: Durable generic chat and encrypted attachment service above Murmur groups

scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.test:browser: mkdir -p ../../.context && esbuild sources/index.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=esm --outfile=../../.context/chat-service-browser-smoke.mjs && node --input-type=module -e "globalThis.Buffer = undefined; globalThis.process = undefined; await import('../../.context/chat-service-browser-smoke.mjs');"
